samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU. Supports arithmetic and logical operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for operation selection.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred.</output>
        <output id="flag">Flag for comparison operations.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param name="ADD">6'b100000</param>
        <param name="ADDU">6'b100001</param>
        <param name="SUB">6'b100010</param>
        <param name="SUBU">6'b100011</param>
        <param name="AND">6'b100100</param>
        <param name="OR">6'b100101</param>
        <param name="XOR">6'b100110</param>
        <param name="NOR">6'b100111</param>
        <param name="SLT">6'b101010</param>
        <param name="SLTU">6'b101011</param>
        <param name="SLL">6'b000000</param>
        <param name="SRL">6'b000010</param>
        <param name="SRA">6'b000011</param>
        <param name="SLLV">6'b000100</param>
        <param name="SRLV">6'b000110</param>
        <param name="SRAV">6'b000111</param>
        <param name="LUI">6'b001111</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]" description="Register to hold the result of the operation." />
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Signed wires for inputs
        wire signed [31:0] a_signed = $signed(a);
        wire signed [31:0] b_signed = $signed(b);
        
        // Assign output port 'r' to the lower 32 bits of the register 'res'
        assign r = res[31:0];
        
        // Assign flag output based on control signal 'aluc'
        assign flag = (aluc == 6'b101010 || aluc == 6'b101011) ? 1 : 1'bz;
        
        // Assign zero output based on result
        assign zero = &res ? 0 : 1;
        
        // Always block triggered by changes in control signal 'aluc', input 'a', or input 'b'
        always @(aluc or a or b) begin
            case(aluc)
                6'b100000: res <= a + b; // ADD
                6'b100001: res <= a + b; // ADDU
                6'b100010: res <= a - b; // SUB
                6'b100011: res <= a - b; // SUBU
                6'b100100: res <= a & b; // AND
                6'b100101: res <= a | b; // OR
                6'b100110: res <= a ^ b; // XOR
                6'b100111: res <= ~(a | b); // NOR
                6'b101010: res <= a_signed < b_signed ? 1 : 0; // SLT
                6'b101011: res <= a < b ? 1 : 0; // SLTU
                6'b000000: res <= b << a; // SLL
                6'b000010: res <= b >> a; // SRL
                6'b000011: res <= b_signed >>> a; // SRA
                6'b000100: res <= b << a[4:0]; // SLLV
                6'b000110: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // SRLV
                6'b000111: res <= b_signed >>> a[4:0]; // SRAV
                6'b001111: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0}; // LUI
                default: res <= 32'hz; // Default case
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
